username.description: Mixpanel service account username. The custom hook also accepts username_secret when this non-secret config value is unset.

base_url.description: Mixpanel API base URL for the operation family. Query commands default to https://mixpanel.com/api/query; App API streams/writes use https://mixpanel.com/api/app; ingestion/identity use https://api.mixpanel.com; export/data pipelines use https://data.mixpanel.com/api/2.0. Override per credential or command config as needed.
